name: Import
description: Importers that read the vector formats export writes, its inverse: the contract for an SVG document read into one scene and a Lottie JSON document read into a document, with byte, element, layer and depth caps, a typed ImportError and an ImportReport listing what was skipped; and SVGPathData, which reads SVG path data (every command, absolute and relative, arcs as cubics) into a Path. The document readers are stubs that throw unsupported until they are built.

relationships.description: builds scenes, layers, shapes and fills
